svg.title: Erza, The Paired Witness
svg.desc: An armored goddess with silver-white hair stands at night between two identical sealed arenas where the same champion faces the same trial. She lays a glowing violet Skill scroll into the left arena and leaves the right arena bare, while a balance beam across her shoulders tips toward a pan heaped with stone weights and away from an empty pan. Around her a scribe writes in a growing stone ledger, a smith hammers a sealed crate at an anvil, an assayer tends a glowing crucible beside small scales, and a gatekeeper holds a seal at an arched gate. Warm gold light falls from the upper left.
svg.text: What a Skill changes, weighed in paired runs, never asserted
